description: This file defines the Java interface 'ReportingProcessService' which declares methods for processing report requests, retrieving export targets, and report parameters within the Fineract infrastructure reporting module.

classes.name: ReportingProcessService
classes.description: Interface declaring reporting processing methods such as processing requests, obtaining export options, and report parameters.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Handles processing of a report request given its name and query parameters.

methods.name: getAvailableExportTargets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available report export formats or targets.

methods.name: getReportParams
methods.description: Returns report parameters based on query parameters provided.
